summary: Ardent agents through Magnus: sessions, unbuffered task event streams and streamed artifacts; Ardent 2.2.0 missions, task pause and resume, previews and development history (node agent studio capability 2); New Agent deployment as a durable, resumable, audited operation; per-agent HiveMem credentials for new and existing profiles, renewed before every deadline; linked Oathweave service identities confined to the Ardent bridge; failed Ardent actions that settle their command owner, and an audited ADMIN reconciliation for an unknown outcome; HiveSkills catalog skills installed onto Ardent profiles, checked against the catalog digest (node agent studio capability 3).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS HiveMem base URL that issues per-agent credentials for Ardent New Agent and Enable HiveMem.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN
newOptionalEnv.description: HiveMem token with admin:agents for installs without Oathweave; the Oathweave machine client is preferred and the two are mutually exclusive.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_WORKSPACE_ID
newOptionalEnv.description: Existing HiveMem workspace Ardent agents join.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_AGENT_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HiveMem base URL written into Ardent profile configs when agents reach HiveMem at another address.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_CREDENTIAL_HOURS
newOptionalEnv.description: Lifetime of an Ardent agent HiveMem credential, 1 to 720 hours (default 720).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_EMBERPATH_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: OpenAI-compatible Emberpath base URL used for an Ardent agent's Emberpath model alias.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_ARDENT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES
newOptionalEnv.description: Largest Ardent artifact the agent streams, in bytes (default 64 MiB).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_CLIENT_ID
newOptionalEnv.description: Oathweave machine client (audience hivemem) Magnus uses to enroll and renew Ardent agent HiveMem credentials; preferred over the enrollment token.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_CLIENT_SECRET
newOptionalEnv.description: Secret of the Oathweave HiveMem machine client.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_TOKEN_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: Oathweave OAuth token endpoint for the HiveMem machine client.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_SCOPE
newOptionalEnv.description: Scope requested for the HiveMem machine client token (default: agent enrollment, workspace, memory and session permissions).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVESKILLS_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS HiveSkills registry that Ardent skill-install fetches catalog releases from; unset, skill-install answers 503.
